criteria.requirement: Implement xlsxwriter.utc.as_utc(datetime,*,naive="raise") and write_utc(worksheet,row,col,value,cell_format=None,*,naive="raise"). Convert aware values by instant to naive UTC before actual write_datetime, preserving fractional seconds and input identity. Default rejects naive datetimes; explicit naive="utc" accepts them. Use utcoffset semantics and DST fold correctly, keep workbook 1900/1904 date modes and native return codes/formats, never globally enable remove_timezone or silently discard offsets. Existing write_datetime behavior stays compatible.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
